subject: Prototype evaluation: extension & conversion structuring
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@novacore.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novacore Procurement <procurement@novacore.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:34:00 -0800
Subject: Prototype evaluation: request for 2-week extension & pricing clarification

Hi Jonas / Irene,

Thanks for the support so far — the team has run the final throughput batch (attached usage_summary_novacore-20261119.csv) and we hit ~85% of our target at peak load. We need an extra two weeks of the prototype window to validate model warms and KV caching under sustained traffic before we can sign a conversion PO.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood extend the current time-boxed evaluation by 14 calendar days at no incremental charge?
- If not, would you consider a token-credit top-up instead (we estimate ~150k tokens needed for the additional tests)?

Procurement has flagged budget timing — they cannot commit to a conversion without the extra validation. If we move forward on an extension, please outline any conversion commitments or timeline expectations on your side so Procurement can scope approvals.

Appreciate a quick confirmation; we aim to finalize internal evaluation notes by 12/08.

Best,
Maya Singh
Sr Product Manager, Novacore.ai

Attachments: usage_summary_novacore-20261119.csv
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@novacore.ai>
Cc: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prototype evaluation: request for 2-week extension & pricing clarification

Maya — thanks for the report and the clear ask. We can do this, and I want to propose two pragmatic options so Procurement can choose the least-friction path: 

Option A — Trial extension (preferred for speed)
- 14 calendar days extension to the current prototype at no extra charge
- Condition: a verbal conversion intent (email from an exec) or a signed LOI within 10 business days after the extension ends

Option B — Token top-up (no time extension)
- 150k token credit added to your account immediately
- 10% discount on Redwood usage for first 3 months after conversion

If neither works, we can consider a hybrid: a 7-day extension + 100k token credit. I've attached a short proposition (proposal-novacore-v3.pdf) that maps each option to conversion milestones and our suggested timeline.

Also: procurement terms — Net30 vs Net45, invoicing milestone expectations — please confirm what Novacore prefers so we can loop in Finance.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow to run through the tradeoffs.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposal-novacore-v3.pdf
From: Maya Singh <maya@novacore.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novacore Procurement <procurement@novacore.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prototype evaluation: request for 2-week extension & pricing clarification

Thanks Jonas — I reviewed both options with Procurement and Eng. A few points from our side:

- We cannot provide a commitment or LOI until the extended run proves sustained 1k RPS for 48 hours. The team will run that during the window you provide.
- Procurement is constrained on headcount and cannot move to Net30; they prefer Net45 on the initial commercial engagement.
- Given the uncertainty, they're asking for a larger token cushion: 150k credits + a 20% discount on the first 2 months to offset integration risk.

If Redwood can do Option A (14 days) plus a 100k token credit and 15% discount, Procurement may be able to stretch to a conditional LOI (exec email confirming intent to purchase pending metrics).

Would that be something you can accept? If so, I can escalate internally and get the PO draft ready.

From: david_kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prototype evaluation: request for 2-week extension & pricing clarification

Jonas / Irene — internal note on concessions from Finance:

Summary recommendation (compromise):
- Approve Option A: 14-day extension (no charge)
- Add 100k token credit to Novacore account immediately
- 15% discount on usage for the first full billing quarter after conversion
- Requirement: signed PO within 10 business days of the end of the extension; standard T&Cs (no additional SLA exceptions)

Rationale: 100k + 15% materially reduces friction for the customer while protecting our unit economics. We should insist on the PO deadline to avoid indefinite runway. If Procurement insists on 150k or 20%, escalate to VP Sales for approval.

If you want, I can pre-authorize drafting a one-page amendment for signature to keep legal work minimal.

-david
David Kim
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

(On original thread: Maya — see David's recommendation below; we view this as the lowest-risk route to close.)
From: Maya Singh <maya@novacore.ai>

Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prototype evaluation: request for 2-week extension & pricing clarification

Thanks — that compromise is acceptable to Novacore. Two small asks before we sign:
1) Can billing be Net45 for the first invoiced quarter?
2) We'll attach a PO that references the 14-day extension + 100k token credit + 15% introductory discount; please confirm the amendment language is minimal (one-pager).

I've attached the PO draft (po_draft_novacore.docx) for your review. Once you confirm Net45 and the amendment form, Procurement will sign and return.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — looking forward to a smooth close.

Best,
Maya Singh
Sr Product Manager, Novacore.ai
